chunkanimator.config.title: Chunk Animator
chunkanimator.config.mode.below.tooltip: Chunks always rise up from below.
chunkanimator.config.mode.above.tooltip: Chunks always drop down from above.
chunkanimator.config.mode.hybrid.tooltip: Chunks below the horizon rise up from below; chunks above it drop down from above.
chunkanimator.config.mode.horizontal_sli: Chunks slide in from the side they are on, relative to you.
Like Horizontal Slide, but the direction is picked when the chunk is first drawn. With Sodium this looks the same as Horizontal Slide.
chunkanimator.config.easingFunction.quad: Starts fast and gently slows down.
chunkanimator.config.easingFunction.cubi: Starts fast and slows down a little more strongly than Quad.
chunkanimator.config.easingFunction.quar: Starts very fast and slows down strongly.
chunkanimator.config.easingFunction.quin: Starts very fast and slows down very strongly.
chunkanimator.config.easingFunction.expo: Shoots most of the way in, then creeps into place.
chunkanimator.config.easingFunction.circ: Fast start with a sharp, rounded stop.
chunkanimator.config.easingFunction.back: Overshoots slightly, then settles back into place.
chunkanimator.config.easingFunction.boun: Bounces a few times as it lands.
chunkanimator.config.easingFunction.elas: Wobbles like a spring before settling.
chunkanimator.config.animationDuration.t: How long each chunk takes to move into place. Off disables the animation.
chunkanimator.config.disableAroundPlayer: Chunks within 64 blocks of you appear instantly instead of animating.
